script:
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/goal/stop" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/goal" --auth none --json '{"objective": "QA_F11 x"}' --expect 401 --save F11.goal-auth/goal-none
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/goal" --auth bad --json '{"objective": "QA_F11 x"}' --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/goal/stop" --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/goal/stop" --auth bad --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/goal/resume" --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/goal/resume" --auth bad --expect 401 --save F11.goal-auth/resume-bad
control-agent-server conversation events "$X" --key goal --expect-count 0
